structural.name: rotelle
structural.note: Name 'rigatoni rotelle' conflates two unrelated shapes (rigatoni = ridged tubes vs rotelle = wagon wheels). All four aliases are rotelle/wheel terms, so the item IS rotelle. The 'rigatoni' token risks a 'rigatoni' query surfacing this wheel pasta (and vice versa) when the distinct 'rigatoni' item already exists.
Id matches the corrected name. 'rotelle' id is free and the item has no children, so the reid repoints cleanly.
